cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Free, no registration. Build your professional resume in minutes.

free.a: Yes. ZiYou Resume is completely free, with no paid features or subscriptions. All features are available directly.

privacy.q: Will my resume data be uploaded to a server?
privacy.a: No. All resume data is stored in your browser's local storage. Unless you actively export it, the data never leaves your device.

ai.q: What do I need to configure to use AI polishing?
ai.a: You need to fill in an API Key from any AI provider (such as Doubao, DeepSeek, OpenAI, or Gemini) in settings. Requests go directly from your browser to the provider, without passing through our server.

export.q: Will the exported PDF have a watermark?
export.a: No. The exported PDF is completely watermark-free, with layout identical to what you see in the editor preview.
